title: Autonomous Runner Bounded Repair Smoke
goal: Exercise the runner's single bounded repair pass using one isolated docs/testing evidence file.

include: Autonomous runner bounded repair smoke evidence

acceptance: On the initial execution pass, create the smoke evidence file with exactly MyOwnWorld bounded repair smoke INITIAL FAIL.
On the repair pass only, replace the evidence file content with exactly MyOwnWorld bounded repair smoke PASS.
No product runtime, roadmap or persistent-format file is modified.

commands.command: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const p='docs/03-testing/agent-tasks/smoke-output/bounded-repair-smoke.txt';if(!fs.existsSync(p))process.exit(1);const text=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').trim();if(text!=='MyOwnWorld bounded repair smoke PASS')process.exit(1);"
commands.reason: The bounded repair smoke passes only after the allowed repair replaces the initial failure marker.
The smoke output must not introduce whitespace errors.

risk.notes: The task is constrained to a single testing evidence file and intentionally fails until the runner's one repair pass.

notes: This task is intended only for the bounded repair live smoke.
The runner must not commit, merge or push the task branch.
The repair pass is recognized by the prompt line THIS IS THE ONLY REPAIR ATTEMPT.
